name: Sergeant Cessa Dorn
description: Wants a quiet contract; owes obedience. Accepts lawful restraint or paid withdrawal when credible, not by automatic defection.

score.want: Keep the company paid and avoid pointless losses
score.ought: Wants a quiet contract; owes obedience. Accepts lawful restraint or paid withdrawal when credible, not by automatic defection.
tactics: withdraw or resist a concrete threat
observed: d9/day: after departing White Cairn dawn and half-day cart journey, encountered unknown knight and surveyor at Wind Stair. Introduced herself and asked route condition, no knowledge of Serevan conversation.

d9/day Wind Stair: surveyor warned foot passage possible but loaded cart should be belayed. Asked unknown knight to help cross; answer pending. No knowledge of private inspection or Serevan discussion.

d9/day voice continuation: unknown knight helped belay cart, was friendly/professional, described self as hired hand. Agreed to tell Three Hearths they are friendly, not bandits, helping road. No delivery yet.

d10/day: Hrill objected to guest exclusion under road licence and asked why Serevan was singled out. Admitted no charge supplied with instruction, offered to ask Vaust; no knowledge of relic or prior Hrill/Serevan meeting.

d10/day: Hrill asked whether Vaust would discuss exclusion as question of honor. Offered introduction at White Cairn if he returns with escort; no threat or challenge to duel assumed, invitation unanswered.

d11/dusk: Heard Serevan burial-item claim and Vaust admit standard removed from dig. At Vaust direction unlocked chest and exposed engraved metal standard-head. Now knows this object's identity and location, not sale purpose or provenance beyond statements.

doing.next: Arrived White Cairn d15/dusk, reported rent and working post; no further movement assigned

assets.lease_document: Delivered signed original to Serevan d14/dusk
assets.post_shelter: Existing camp canvas tent packed at rock shoulder; erection pending

temporary_custody.key: Vaust relic-chest key handed over to open shed-wagon chest; not returned yet

actor_notes: LOOKS: compact woman with close-cropped hair, leather armour and a mended shield strap. CORE: promises to soldiers mean wages and a route home. NATURE: blunt, likes good meals and undramatic company. WOUND: survived a commander who spent people to save face. WANTS: paid people and no futile fight. PRESSURE: narrows demands, withdraws if she can, fights if trapped. KEY: economical speech, no military philosophy.
